title: LSD-3D: Large-Scale 3D Driving Scene Generation with Geometry Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2508.19204v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large-scale scene data is essential for training and testing in robot learning. Neural reconstruction methods have promised the capability of reconstructing large physically-grounded outdoor scenes from captured sensor data. However, these methods have baked-in static environments and only allow for limited scene control -- they are functionally constrained in scene and trajectory diversity by the captures from which they are reconstructed. In contrast, generating driving data with recent image or video diffusion models offers control, however, at the cost of geometry grounding and causality. translated_title: LSD-3D：具有几何锚定的大规模3D驾驶场景生成
translated_abstract: 大规模场景数据对于机器人学习的训练和测试至关重要。神经重建方法有望从采集的传感器数据中重建大型且具有物理基础的室外场景。然而，这些方法将静态环境固化在场景中，仅允许有限的场景控制——它们在场景和轨迹多样性上受限于用于重建的采集数据。相比之下，利用近期的图像或视频扩散模型生成驾驶数据虽然可以提供控制能力，但代价是失去几何锚定和因果性。在本工作中，我们旨在弥合这一差距，提出了一种直接生成具有精确几何的大规模3D驾驶场景的方法，支持具有物体永久性和显式3D几何估计的因果新视角合成。所提出的方法将代理几何与环境表示的生成相结合……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种直接生成具有精确几何的大规模3D驾驶场景的方法，弥合了神经重建方法场景多样性受限与扩散模型生成缺乏几何锚定之间的差距，实现了支持物体永久性的因果新视角合成和显式3D几何估计。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a method that directly generates large-scale 3D driving scenes with accurate geometry, bridging the gap between neural reconstruction methods (limited scene diversity) and diffusion-based generation (lacking geometry grounding), enabling causal novel view synthesis with object permanence and explicit 3D geometry estimation.
